sources.title: Qwen3-VL-32B Ultra Uncensored Heretic — MiniMax-H3 ComfyUI INT8 ConvRot
sources.snippet: Provides ComfyUI-ready INT8 MiniMax‑H3 checkpoints (conditioning encoder plus optional generation tail) for a Heretic-edited Qwen3‑VL‑32B source; preserves the vision tower in BF16 and uses row-wise ConvRot INT8 quantization to reduce VRAM needs for ~32GB GPUs. Not a full Transformers generation repository.
